sentence: كِيف حَالَك أَبْغَى أَبْعَت email لِلْمُدِير دَحِّين
raw: كيف حالك أبغى أبعت email للمدير دحين
ipa: ˈkiːf ˈħaːlak ˈʔabɣaː ˈʔabʕat imeːl lilmuˈdiːr daħˈħiːn
gloss_en: how are you, I want to send an email to the manager now
notes: [tech] email→imeːl (loan into 8-vowel set, mid /eː/ present). Hejazi frame كيف حالك/أبغى/دحّين/مو/زين/هادا/مرّة (omar1975; abdoh2010), no Cairene lexicon. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: عِنْدِي laptop جَدِيد بَس wifi بَطِيء
raw: عندي laptop جديد بس wifi بطيء
ipa: ˈʕindiː labtub dʒaˈdiːd ˈbas wifi bɑˈtˤiːʔ
gloss_en: I have a new laptop but the wifi is slow
notes: [tech] laptop→labtub (/p/→[b], watson2002); wifi→wifi (all segments native). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I forgot the password of the email
notes: [tech] password→baswuːrd (/p/→[b]); email→imeːl. Hejazi possessive حَقّ (omar1975). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: عِنْدِي meeting مُهِمّ مَعَ manager بُكْرَة
raw: عندي meeting مهم مع manager بكرة
ipa: ˈʕindiː miːtinɡ muˈhimm ˈmaʕa manadʒar ˈbukra
gloss_en: I have an important meeting with a manager tomorrow
notes: [work] meeting→miːtinɡ (/ŋ/→[nɡ]); manager→manadʒar — Hejazi keeps loan /dʒ/ (ج=/dʒ/, abdoh2010), UNLIKE Cairene [manaɡar]. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: we have to do an update for the program now
notes: [tech] update→abdat (/p/→[b], initial cluster resolved). دَحِّين 'now' Hejazi (abdoh2010). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: أَنَا think هَادَا model غَالِي مَرَّة
raw: أنا think هادا model غالي مرة
ipa: ˈʔanaː θink ˈhaːdaː mudil ˈɣaːliː ˈmarra
gloss_en: I think this model is very expensive
notes: [daily] think→θink — default table keeps interdental /θ/, UNLIKE Cairene [tink]; model→mudil. Intensifier مَرَّة 'very' (omar1975). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: فِي offer زَين وْ discount كْبِير
raw: في offer زين و discount كبير
ipa: ˈfiː ufar ˈzeːn w disawnt ˈkbiːr
gloss_en: there is a good offer and a big discount
notes: [commerce] offer→ufar; discount→disawnt. Hejazi زَين 'good' (omar1975). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: payment is cash, not by card
notes: [commerce] cash→kaʃ. Predicate negator مُو /muː/ (Hejazi, omar1975), not Cairene mish. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: service مُو زَين وْ delivery مِتْأَخِّر
raw: service مو زين و delivery متأخر
ipa: sarfis ˈmuː ˈzeːn w dilifari mitˈʔaxxir
gloss_en: the service is not good and the delivery is late
notes: [commerce] service→sarfis (/v/→[f]); delivery→dilifari. مُو negator + زَين (omar1975). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I took the car to a garage now
notes: [automotive] garage→ɡaːradʒ — Hejazi keeps final loan /dʒ/ (ج=/dʒ/, abdoh2010), UNLIKE Cairene [ɡaːraɡ]. وَدَّيت→[waddeːt] /aj/→[eː] (omar1975). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: this model is new and automatic
notes: [automotive] model→mudil; automatic→aatumatik. Demonstrative هَادَا (abdoh2010); جَدِيد ج=/dʒ/. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: نَشُوفَك فِي weekend إِن شَاء الله
raw: نشوفك في weekend إن شاء الله
ipa: naˈʃuːfak ˈfiː wiːkind ˈʔin ˈʃaːʔ ˈallah
gloss_en: we'll see you on the weekend, God willing
notes: [daily] weekend→wiːkind. نَشُوفَك 'we see you' (omar1975). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: the car went for a service this morning
notes: [automotive] loan سرفيس 'service (station)' → saˈrfiːs (/v/→[f]); attested urban Hejazi/Gulf [sarfiːs]. Pipeline reads the vocalised loan natively and matches. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I paid cash, not by card
notes: [commerce] loan كاش 'cash' → kaːʃ, matches attested [kaːʃ]; كرت 'card'→kart. مُو negator (omar1975). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: this gear is automatic
notes: [automotive] loan أوتوماتيك 'automatic' → [ʔutumaːtik] attested; pipeline lengthens the mater vowels. STRESS BUG (documented): pipeline emits ʔuːtuːmaˈːtiːk — ˈ placed inside the length mark; engine truth, kept pinned. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: call me on the mobile tomorrow
notes: [tech] loan موبايل 'mobile'; attested [mobaːjil] with loan mid vowel [o]. PIPELINE WRONG: emits 'lmuˈːbaːjil' — reads و as [uː] not [o] and misplaces stress (ˈ inside length mark). Correct loan IPA pinned in ipa. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: we sat watching television
notes: [daily] loan تلفزيون 'television'; attested [tilifizjoːn] with loan mid [oː]. PIPELINE WRONG: emits 'tilifiˈzjuːn' — reads يُو as [juː] not the loan [joː]. Correct loan IPA pinned in ipa. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: how are you, what's your news
notes: [daily] Arabizi (3arabi): 7=ح, 5=خ. Spells كيف حالك أيش أخبارك. Pipeline has no Arabizi path (translit never sniffs Latin as Arabic); ipa is the Hejazi reading of the spelt sentence (omar1975).

gloss_en: I want to go to the market with Khalid
notes: [daily] Arabizi: 7=ح, 3=ع, 5=خ. Spells أبغى أروح السوق مع خالد. unsupported (no Arabizi path); ipa = Hejazi reading, qaf→[ɡ] in sūg (omar1975; abdoh2010).

gloss_en: come see the house later
notes: [daily] Arabizi: 3=ع. Spells تعال شوف البيت بعدين. unsupported; ipa = Hejazi reading, /aj/→[eː] monophthong in bēt/baʕdēn (omar1975).
